notes.title: Dorsaka July Update
notes.notes:
July 2025 Update!



If you're watching twitter/x then you'll already know I delayed this update - normally these take place on the 15th of each month.  I was travelling and so if anything didn't go according to plan or if I needed to make a quick change or update, I couldn't easily do it!  

I'm going back to 15th for August as I have no more travel plans....at least not for now as I'm going to start a huge push to complete a game in the next few months.....more to come on that.....but for now.....heres the quick Dorsaka patch notes!



Dorsaka Patch Notes

Version 1.3 -  26 July 2025

Items and Fixes

Brazilian Portuguese Language added

Added key hints to language select screen update

notes.title: Dorsaka Monthly Update

Version 1.2 -  15 June 2025



Items and Fixes

- Language selection screen added when starting game

- Japanese translation added

- Fixed bug which keeps the player on the God of Life screen

notes.title: Dorsaka May Update
notes.notes:
Dorsaka Patch Notes

Version 1.1 -  15 May 2025

Items and Fixes
- Added version number to title screen
- Edited walking sound effect (reduced/removed clipping effect)
- Sacred Herb
  - Fixed issue with sacred herb not working as intended
  - Changed Sound effect played when collecting herb
  - visual cue added to HUD when "under the influence"
- Added placeholder code for language translations

Known Bugs
- Mac version limitation
  - Doesnt work on modern 64-bit systems (32-bit only)
    Possible gatekeeper/build issue.

Other Business
- Japanese language translation delayed, our translator has disappeared.
  (they did say something about an ultra-magnetic reactor or something!)
- Nothing else, really.  Just working on stuff!  Hope everything is good with you!
